{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast bias when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) — model tends to overestimate prices.",
    "Adjust downward for forecasts that overshoot recent highs — especially after spikes in price or sentiment.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast deviates > ±10% from 5-day moving average of true outcomes.",
    "Lower forecast for 30-day horizon when sentiment is neutral or negative — model overreacts to short-term sentiment.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is negative — model underreacts to bearish signals.",
    "Avoid over-optimistic forecasts when sentiment is mixed (e.g., 0.00 or small ±0.20) — model tends to overfit recent trends.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is lower than forecast, reduce forecast by 5–10% for next period if sentiment remains neutral or negative."
  ]
}
